question: How long does Manitoba health coverage generally continue after I permanently move to another Canadian province?
generated_answer: The health care coverage provided by Manitoba generally continues for a period of up to three months after you permanently move to another province. You are responsible for paying any Manitoba health care premiums that are due during this period. If you are moving to another province, you should contact the health care authority in that province to find out when your coverage starts. If you are moving to another country, you should contact the Manitoba Health, Healthy Living and Seniors Authority to find out when your coverage ends. You may be eligible for a refund of any Manitoba health care premiums that you have paid. You should contact the Manitoba Health, Healthy Living and Seniors Authority to find out more.
